name: FORGE
features: Barcode lookup retries a 12-digit UPC with an equivalent leading-zero EAN-13 alias when needed
Incomplete Open Food Facts v3 results can be checked against the older v2 product record
Interactive serving-nutrition preview and visible unknown vs explicitly zero nutrient fields
Source and barcode-verification labels distinguish personal, community and name-selected foods
All logged foods remain user-confirmed; past nutrition, training and progress records are preserved
